This is annual 2022 data with no separate Q4 figures, so quarterly cells stay empty. For provisions, I need to pull the net expenses from credit quality changes — 555.4 billion for the year versus 141.5 for the base period — and I'll use the table row rather than the narrative sentence since it captures both figures together.

EPS falls sharply, 12.39 vs 56.98, down 78.3%, scoring -2. Fee income rises 15.4% (697.1 vs 604.2), scoring +2. Corporate loans grow 13.2% excluding FX effects, base 16,711 billion, value 18.6 trillion, scoring +1. Digital MAU grows 2.5 million to 78.6, a modest 3.3% increase, scoring +1.

CIR deteriorates sharply, 41.6% vs 34.0%, up 7.6pp, scoring -2. Portfolio quality improves — stage 3 loans down to 3.9%, a 100bp drop, plus better coverage — scoring +1. Market share gains are broad: consumer +0.6, credit cards +2.6, SME +5.2, mortgage steady at high levels, scoring +1 with SME as the standout quote.

CEO tone reflects crisis language — "most difficult," "anti-crisis plan," "strictest economy" — scoring -2. Tech development shows measurable progress with 80% of the critical landscape migrated, scoring +1. Retail loans grow 12.2% (12,430 vs 11,078), scoring +1. ROE collapses to 5.2% from 24.2%, a steep 19.0pp decline.

Individual active clients grow just 2.8% (106.7 vs 103.8), below the 3% threshold, scoring 0; corporate clients grow 3.4%, but individuals are the primary metric so overall score stays 0. Net profit falls 78.3%, scoring -2. NIM slips slightly from 5.38 to 5.31, scoring 0. Opex declines 1.5% but lacks a comparable base, scoring 0.

Dividends get a positive nod with language about revisiting the payout question, scoring +1. NII rises 6.6%, scoring +1. Customer funds grow 9.1% (29,876 vs 27,392), scoring +1. BVPS rises 3.1% (257.4 vs 249.6), scoring +1. Capital adequacy (N20.0) improves to 14.4% from 13.6%, up 0.8pp, scoring +1.

External conditions are harsh — sanctions, rate hikes, some H2 stabilization — landing on a severe -2 score. Cost of risk worsens sharply, 1.9% vs 0.6%, up 1.3pp, scoring -2. No guidance given, scoring 0.
